task.title: Inspect configured settings
task.shortdesc: Use Configured mode to understand what the profile currently applies by domain, category, and source.

prereq.p: Open a saved profile in All Settings.

context.p: Configured mode focuses on values already present in the profile, not on every possible policy. Domain summaries help you explain the active configuration.

info.p: Expected result: the All Settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Review the configured summary cards by domain or category.

info.p: Expected result: the All Settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Open a category to inspect the settings applied there.

info.p: Expected result: the All Settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Use source filters if you need to separate baseline, CIS, manual, imported, or raw values.

info.note: Changing settings can affect the exported Firefox policy. Review source, validation, and schema support before saving.

result.p: You can describe the active policy and managed preference values applied by the profile.

postreq.p: Recovery: if a value is missing, switch to Catalog mode or clear source filters before deciding it is absent.
